results.title: Odd Man In
results.overview: Explores the complex double life of Donald Webster Cory, a mysterious writer who helped ignite the early gay rights movement—and then betrayed it.

results.title: Pimpin ‘  Ain’t Eazy
results.overview: In Oakland, a former abuse survivor turned female pimp runs her male escort business with her mentor's guidance. When a jobless man accidentally enters their world, he must adapt to an unexpected new life.

results.title: Sabrina Carpenter at Lollapalooza in Brazil
results.original_title: Sabrina Carpenter at Lollapalooza in Brazil

results.title: Myspace
results.overview: What is the legacy of Myspace? Pulling at the heartstrings of millennials and curious newcomers alike, this nostalgic portrait traces how this pioneering social networking platform shaped the digital world we now inhabit, from online fame to social media overload.

results.title: Lunar Sway
results.overview: Cliff is struggling with his love life in a desert town when he unexpectedly connects with his estranged birth mother. After learning of his mom’s string of secrets, Cliff is led on a wild misadventure while also spending time with his love interest, Stew, a mysterious dentist.

results.title: Now's Your Time
results.overview: Death is in Christine's kitchen. She's going to die today. Christine has one thought: F*** it.

results.title: Driving Europe
results.overview: More and more goods are being transported on Europe's roads, yet work conditions for truck drivers are getting worse and worse. Exploitative dependency and wage dumping. A broken system! The film relentlessly exposes how disenfranchisement has become the norm.

results.title: Endless Days
results.overview: Jing, a woman living in Taiwan, visits Japan after receiving a letter from Kasumi, who once had an affair with her father. As she spends time with the now-ill Kasumi, their quiet conversations lead her to confront her father's hidden emotions—and her own long-buried loneliness.

results.title: The Ghost Story.
results.overview: Everyone in town knows Simón's story, because like a rumor or an urban legend, it has been spreading among its inhabitants, the few who believe him and those who question everything about his story... But Simón will clear up doubts, recounting what happened during those supernatural events...

results.title: The Hope Ryder Trilogy
results.overview: An introverted programmer meets a mysterious man who created something that changes her entire reality.  Strange events start to follow.

results.title: Crushed
results.overview: After a drunken night, Jack becomes convinced he fatally struck his sister with his car. Years later, the weight of that night still haunts his family as they struggle with guilt and grief inside the walls of their father’s business.

results.title: Végapolis
results.overview: Laser lights, thumping bass and blades on ice. Inside a Montpellier rink, teens gather each week, forging friendships, dissecting crushes and dreaming. With big life changes on the horizon, this kaleidoscopic coming-of-age portrait captures the joy, intensity and fragile magic of youth.

results.title: The Color of the Sun
results.overview: During summer break on Okinawa's main island, Kamei and his friends face uncertain futures, until they meet Colin, a teenager from the American base in Naha, and everything changes.

results.title: Road Head
results.overview: A young man tries to get his driver's license to fulfill his lifelong dream.

results.title: Better Apart
results.overview: As Marisa’s friends try to stop her from going to her boyfriends, Dom scours the city for his apartment keys in preparation for their date.

results.title: Blush Red
results.overview: A short film inspired by Kevin Atwater's album of the same name. Two men meet late one night at a bar on New York's Lower East Side and walk home together, falling in love along the way. Filmed on the streets of NYC.
